core_obligations: Replace reducedness by the conjunction of (S_1) and (R_0) (proof lines 10544-10546).
Apply ascent of the two conditions along the regular map (proof lines 10547-10549).
Conclude reducedness of the target (proof lines 10549-10550).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a Noetherian target of a regular ring map from a reduced Noetherian ring is again reduced. The proof uses the criterion that for Noetherian rings reducedness is equivalent to the conjunction of the two conditions (S_1) and (R_0), and then applies the two corresponding ascent statements for these conditions along a regular map, which give both conditions for the target and hence reducedness.
